What is carpal tunnel syndrome?

It's a very common condition that happens when a nerve in your wrist becomes squeezed.

What causes carpal tunnel syndrome?

It usually happens from a combination of things, such as:

  • Injury to your wrist
  • Health conditions, for example:
    • Diabetes.
    • Rheumatoid arthritis.

What are the treatments for carpal tunnel syndrome?

They may include:

  • Rest.
  • Medicines:
    • Over-the-counter pain relievers
  • Surgery to make more space.
